text:
The plate looks like a side plate, roughly 22 cm across including the rim. In the image it spans about 525 px, so that is roughly 0.042 cm per px, or about 24 px per cm.

The meatloaf measures about 280 px long by 150 px wide, which is roughly 11.5 cm by 6 cm. It is perhaps 4 cm thick. That gives a volume of about 11.5 × 6 × 4 ≈ 276 cm³, but the loaf has rounded edges, so I take about 220 cm³. At a density of about 1 g/cm³, that is roughly 200 g.

The loaf could also be a slice of meatloaf. At about 200 g and 1.7 kcal/g, it comes to about 340 kcal.

The 4 baby carrots are about 5 cm long, around 8 g each, so about 30 g. That adds about 12 kcal.

Total: about 230 g and about 355 kcal.
